important_evidence: ACP-DL is a repository for anticancer peptide prediction, linked to the paper ACP-MHCNN (PMID 34880291).
The model uses a multi-headed deep convolutional neural network with sequence, physicochemical, and evolutionary features.
No evidence of antimicrobial peptide prediction; all related papers are about anticancer peptides, gold clusters, GWAS, or bacterial metagenomics.
A web server exists at https://anticancer.pythonanywhere.com/ but may be associated with the broader ACP-MHCNN project.
uncertainties: Whether ACP-DL and ACP-MHCNN are exactly the same model or ACP-DL is an independent implementation.
No explicit mention of training dataset or weights availability.
The web server link may refer to the original ACP-MHCNN, not necessarily ACP-DL.
The matched repositories include two unrelated bacterial metagenomic projects, likely due to imperfect search.
